description: 冰火交界中诞生的原初巨人，是巨人谱系与创世材料的起点。
fullDescription: 尤弥尔诞生于世界形成之前的金伦加鸿沟。寒冷霜气与穆斯贝尔热力在混沌中相遇，融霜滴水获得生命，原初巨人由此出现。本卡表现尤弥尔仍然活着的阶段，因此画面中不能出现后来由其身体形成的大地、山川、海洋与天空。其视觉尺度必须足以让后续‘死后化为世界材料’的叙事成立。
roleInSeries: 建立M01最重要的原初生命主体，并锁定创世前世界尚未形成的视觉Canon。

sourceRefs.note: 创世前冰火相遇、尤弥尔诞生及后续世界材料叙事。

visualThesis: 创世前的尤弥尔必须像一个足以在死后化为世界的原初巨物：巨大人形从冰霜与火焰交汇的宇宙混沌中出现，尺度压倒一切，但背景仍保持无大地、无山川、无河流、无成熟天空的未成形状态。

sourceBoundFacts: 尤弥尔在世界形成前由冰火交汇条件下诞生
后续其身体成为世界材料
interpretationNotes: 具体脸型、发色、胡须、肤色属于艺术设计
巨物尺度为使后续世界材料叙事视觉成立的艺术强化
canon.worldState: 尤弥尔仍活着；世界尚未由其身体形成。不得出现成熟大地、山川、海洋、森林、城市、地平线或普通天空。
mustKeep: 几乎完整身体或足以读出超巨尺度
冰火是大形环境而非细节堆砌
mustAvoid: 已形成的地球/山川/海洋

instructions: 尤弥尔是M01唯一的世界级人形巨物；布里不得复制此体量
与奥德胡姆拉同属原初生命，但一个是世界级巨人、一个是原初神牛

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、胸肩、巨手高细节；身体中等；冰火背景低细节大形。
visual.subjectSeparation: 主体边缘、肤色与双侧冷暖光明确从抽象冰火混沌中分离。

prompt.draft: Ymir as a primordial world-scale giant born where frost and fire meet in Ginnungagap, before the world exists.
prompt.final: Create a vertical 9:16 mythological wallpaper of Ymir BEFORE the creation of the world. Depict Ymir as a primordial giant so colossal that his eventual corpse could plausibly become the material of the world. Use an extreme low-angle, worm's-eye composition and show almost his entire body: his ancient face high in the upper part of the frame, a vast chest and torso dominating the center, enormous arms and hands extending toward the viewer, and massive legs descending into primordial vapor. He should feel titanically larger than any later landscape, like a mythic world-sized being rather than a normal giant or a game boss. IMPORTANT MYTHOLOGICAL STATE: Ymir is still alive, so the world has NOT yet been made from his body. There must be NO mountains, NO land, NO rivers, NO seas, NO forests, NO cities, NO horizon, NO formed Earth, and NO ordinary blue sky. The environment is Ginnungagap in an unformed cosmic-chaos state. On one side, show broad blue-white masses of freezing frost, icy vapor, cold currents and melting rime associated with Niflheim. On the opposite side, show broad deep orange-red masses of primordial flame, incandescent heat and turbulent fire associated with Muspell. Between them is a dark, formless void where cold and heat collide and create the conditions for life. The background must read as abstract primordial ice-and-fire chaos, not as a finished landscape. Ymir's body should emerge from that collision: huge human-like giant anatomy, ancient gray-blue flesh with restrained frost along edges, long pale frost-laden hair and beard, severe timeless face, bare monumental torso, with the lower body modestly obscured by mist, frost and heat vapor where needed. Keep the anatomy massive and believable, but avoid exaggerated bodybuilder proportions. Make Ymir the single dominant visual subject and keep him noticeably sharper, higher-contrast and more readable than the background. Use the ice and fire as large simple environmental masses rather than filling every area with micro-detail. The image should feel monumental and shocking in scale, with a giant-object / colossal-titan effect, but still solemn and mythological. Art direction: painterly mythic illustration, matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, restrained detail, natural imperfect brush-like edges, limited focal sharpness, strong atmospheric depth, clear subject/background separation, dramatic blue-white cold light from one side and ember-orange warm light from the other. Preserve future card crop safety: the face and upper torso must stay safely in the upper half; hands and key anatomy should remain above the lower sacrificial zone; the bottom 30 percent may be cropped later without losing Ymir's identity. No typography, no title, no logo, no watermark, no card frame, no runes, no armor, no weapons, no Earth, no planet, no mountains, no rivers, no vegetation, no architecture, no decorative starfield, no galaxy wallpaper, no floating-debris overload, no glossy game-CG finish, no hyper-detailed-everything.
